findings.detail: NEW GAP introduced by the remediation: the documented re-baseline command cannot run against the committed evidence tree. scripts/docs-deploy/prepare.ts selects fresh-vs-re-verify purely by `const manifestPath = join(args.evidence, 'asset-manifest.json'); const reVerify = existsSync(manifestPath);` (L235-236), and there is no --force/--fresh flag (only --phase, --source, --evidence, --dist; anything else hits fail('unknown argument')). The committed evidence/ORI-DEP-001/asset-manifest.json EXISTS and binds release_sha 10d7f1de, so AC-3's VERIFY prepare.ts --phase bootstrap --source <NEW_HEAD_SHA> takes the RE-VERIFY branch and fails at 'release mismatch: frozen manifest binds 10d7f1de, but --source names <NEW_HEAD_SHA>' before the fresh path can write the new baseline. FIX: add the explicit destructive pre-step to AC-3's VERIFY and the CRITICAL CONSTRAINT - `rm tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-DEP-001/asset-manifest.json` (and build.json) immediately before the fresh prepare.ts run, noting the committed 10d7f1de manifest is being superseded (already allowlisted via evidence/ORI-DEP-001/**).

NEW GAP introduced by the remediation: AC-3's VERIFY ends by consuming a receipt that nothing in the chain regenerates. The tail step `public-http.test.ts --phase bootstrap --origin https://rnraielements.com --receipt .../evidence/ORI-DEP-001/release.json` requires hashOk = sha256(live conversation.json) === receipt.conversation_assets[rel] (L389-390) and process.exit(1) on any failure. release.json is still ORI-DEP-001's attended receipt (release_sha 10d7f1de, initial_version_id 2aef7463, OLD conversation_assets). prepare.ts NEVER writes release.json (grep -c 'release.json' = 0; fresh mode writes only asset-manifest.json + build.json) and no script generates it. Both conversation endpoints carry a self-dep, so their bytes change and the stale hashes cannot match -> hard exit. The CRITICAL CONSTRAINT is factually wrong when it says the new release.json is produced by a fresh prepare.ts run. FIX: (1) correct the mechanism - prepare.ts produces asset-manifest.json + build.json; release.json is written from the attended deploy (new initial_version_id/deployment_id/deployed_at/attended_provenance) and must be updated with the NEW conversation_assets hashes read from the fresh asset-manifest.json; (2) insert that update as an explicit step in AC-3's VERIFY between wrangler deploy and the --receipt invocation (allowlisted via evidence/ORI-DEP-001/**).

Residual wording slip in DONE WHEN: the second clause of AC-1 prints the {engine} TOKEN form while labelled 'substituted form'. The authoritative AC-1 body is correct. Make the second clause read https://rnraielements.com/r/<engine>/<item-name>.json.

NO WEAKENING / NO NEW GAP ELSEWHERE - verified. Diagnosis, all measured counts (56/32/64/19/48/146/14), deploy-proof strength, {version}-removal decision, frozen-file exclusions, and the SHELL-012 disclosure are unchanged. prepare.ts source/clean-tree gates exclude the evidence tree and .tmp, so the re-baseline writes will not trip them.

summary: All three originally-blocking findings (F1/F2/F3) and all six non-blocking ones are genuinely closed, independently re-verified (HEAD input-group.json has ring-2 once in a comment with focusedStyle present and the className token gone; live has it in the className with focusedStyle absent; public-http.test.ts has zero tests). But the remediation's new AC-3 VERIFY chain cannot execute as written: (1) prepare.ts chooses fresh-vs-reverify by existsSync(asset-manifest.json), so the frozen 10d7f1de manifest must be removed first or the re-baseline dies at 'release mismatch'; (2) release.json is never written by prepare.ts, so the --receipt step's conversation_assets can never match the changed conversation bytes. Both fixes are small and target already-allowlisted paths.
